3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:c3ea985b-c0ec.title: Founding Clinician- Women's Health
3yhealth-3y-health:ashbyhq:c3ea985b-c0ec.description: About 3Y At 3Y Health, we believe physicians deserve more — more freedom, more support, and more impact. That’s why we’ve created a platform where physicians can launch and grow your own practice with no upfront costs and full operational support. We handle the logistics. You focus on care. Why This Role Exists We’re expanding our Women's Health services and need a founding clinician to serve as a part‑time consultant. You will help us shape local care models, expand insurance contracts, and if interested, create a launch‑pad to build or grow your own independent practice—without the usual operational headache. Key Responsibilities - We are looking for a variable commitment, up to 1 hr commitment per week - Advise on policies and outcome metrics to ensure evidence‑based, family‑centered care. - Act as the primary credentialed provider for the group when we are applying to commercial and Medicaid plans in your state. Ideal Candidate - Active OBGYN license in good standing in Florida. - Familiarity with payer credentialing or utilization‑management processes is a plus. - Passion for expanding equitable private practice care and experimenting with outcome‑driven models. - Enjoys autonomy and remote, flexible collaboration Compensation Compensation will be $300 per hour.

anotherco-anotherco:lever:a08c5f39-1973-.title: Paid Media & Influencer Marketing Manager
anotherco-anotherco:lever:a08c5f39-1973-.description: OUR JOB IS TO REVOLUTIONIZE THE STRATEGIC COMMUNICATION We are another.co, a global communications agency founded in 2004. we have been transforming the way things are done. Revolution is in our DNA, and it guides every project we undertake. Our mission is clear: to create inspirational, powerful, and creative storytelling that is always culturally relevant, leveraging the integration of our expert teams who can work across any channel, anywhere. Our vision is ambitious: we believe the right stories have the power to change everything. Every campaign, piece of content, and idea that comes from another aims to make a real impact. If you want to join a place where creativity has no limits and impact is real, this is your space. Why Join Us? This is your chance to be part of the another Community, an innovative and multicultural team that’s redefining the rules of communication. If you're passionate about strategy, creativity, and results, this is the place for you. WE ARE HIRING: Paid Media & Influencer Marketing Manager Requirements 4+ years of experience in Paid Media, Performance Marketing, Digital Marketing, and/or Influencer Marketing, preferably within Digital, Influencer Marketing, or Creative agencies. Hands-on experience managing and optimizing campaigns across Meta Ads and TikTok Ads. Experience amplifying Influencer and Creator content through Paid Media strategies. Knowledge of Influencer Marketing and Creator Marketing, including scouting, campaign execution, content management, and performance analysis. Experience managing Paid Media and Influencer Marketing budgets, including allocation, monitoring, optimization, and reallocation based on results. Strong understanding of performance metrics such as CPM, CPC, CTR, CPE, CPV, CPA, conversions, ROAS, and ROI. Experience working with Partnership Ads, Spark Ads, whitelisting, boosting, and creator content amplification. Knowledge of UGC strategies and creator-led content for organic and paid campaigns. Ability to analyze the performance of different creators, audiences, content formats, and platforms to identify optimization opportunities. Strong analytical mindset and ability to translate data into actionable recommendations. Knowledge of tracking, reporting, and digital analytics tools. Advanced English preferred. Activities Plan, implement, monitor, and optimize Paid Media campaigns across Meta Ads and TikTok Ads. Develop Paid Media strategies to amplify Influencer, Creator, and UGC content. Manage campaign budgets and dynamically allocate or reallocate investment according to performance and business objectives. Analyze the performance of creators, content, audiences, formats, and platforms to identify opportunities for optimization. Coordinate with Influencer Marketing teams to select content with the greatest potential for paid amplification and performance. Support the development and execution of Influencer Marketing and Creator Marketing campaigns. Implement and optimize Partnership Ads, Spark Ads, whitelisting, boosting, and other creator amplification formats. Monitor key performance indicators including CPM, CPC, CTR, CPE, CPV, CPA, conversions, ROAS, and ROI. Develop performance reports and translate campaign data into strategic recommendations and actionable insights. Conduct A/B testing across audiences, creators, formats, messaging, and creative assets. Identify high-performing creator content and recommend when to increase, maintain, reallocate, or stop investment. Collaborate with Influencer Marketing, Content, Creative, and Client Service teams to ensure campaigns meet performance and business objectives. crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:37.title: Forklift Mechanic
crestoperations-crestoperations:lever:37.description: With companies located across the United States, The Crest Industries Family of Companies is committed to bringing together the best people and the right resources to meet today’s challenges and deliver the innovations of tomorrow. With significant recent growth and company acquisitions, Crest more than ever is a catalyst for change, using a little grit and a lot of determination to drive a forward movement for our customers and our employees. DESCRIPTION: The Forklift Mechanic’s main responsibility is to evaluate and repair all mobile equipment and forklifts at the plant. This candidate must be able to inspect, troubleshoot, diagnose, repair, and maintain all makes and models of material handling equipment. The other responsibilities would be to communicate to management what parts are needed and call those orders in so the equipment can be repaired. COMPETENCIES: · Customer Focus · Drives Results · Collaborates · Communicates Effectively · WORKING CONDITIONS: ·
responsibilities: Can troubleshoot equipment malfunctions and provide corrective action.
·      Disassembles forklifts prior to maintenance work.
·      Reassembles forklifts after the completion of repair or maintenance work.
·      Starts forklifts and observes mechanical operation to determine efficiency and to detect problems.
·      Inspects or tests damaged forklifts, and marks defective areas or advises supervisors of repair needs.
·      Lubricates or applies adhesives or other materials to forklifts, according to specified procedures.
·      Dismantles forklifts and removes parts for repair, using specified tools.
·      Records production, repair, and forklift maintenance information.
·      Reads work orders and specifications to determine forklifts and other material handling equipment, requiring repair or maintenance.
·      Ability to repair tools and small engines.
·      Holds a working knowledge of hydraulic and electrical systems.
·      Performs scheduled preventative maintenance.
qualifications: High School Diploma or equivalent preferred.
Ability to interpret blueprints required.
Ability to read a tape measure required.
Certifications or prior experience using moving machinery, such as forklifts, required.
2+ years of prior industrial maintenance experience required.
Hydraulic and electrical background experience required.
Regular, and reliable attendance is required.

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:598.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Kitchen Assistant at Sur La Table, you play a key role in inspiring customers throughout every stage of their culinary experience. With a passion for cooking, hospitality, and teamwork, the Kitchen Assistant supports the chefs to ensure smooth class operations and a #bestincenter experience, a company-wide standard for excellence in service. You’ll help bring culinary dreams to life by supporting our chefs, engaging with guests, and ensuring a clean, well-organized kitchen environment. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. · Ensure exceptional customer experience by leading a customer-focused, Guest Obsessed culture in both the kitchen and retail sales floor. Sales & Business Performance · Assist chefs with class execution that drives repeat visits and positive customer feedback · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed monthly sales goals, contributing to overall store revenue. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Physical Requirements · Ability to communicate verbally and work cooperatively with associates and customers · Ability to remain standing for up to 4 hours at a time · Ability to move about the store directing class participants while selling to customers and retrieving merchandise from stockroom or sales floor · The capability to accurately perceive and differentiate variations in intensity or quality of flavors or odors, or to identify specific tastes or scents using the tongue or nose. · Ability to grab, reach, push, pull, bend, stoop, kneel and crouch to demonstrate, retrieve and/or replenish merchandise and/or cooking equipment. · Ability to use hands to seize, hold, grasp, turn, or otherwise to chop, whisk, slice, stir, juice and/or demonstrate other techniques. · Ability to lift and/or move merchandise weighing up to 50 lbs. · Ability to ascend/descend ladders to retrieve and/or move merchandise

jobgether-jobgether:lever:16dc6451-9810-.title: Senior Recreational Marine Facilities Underwriter
jobgether-jobgether:lever:16dc6451-9810-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Recreational Marine Facilities Underwriter based in the United States. This is a remote, full-time senior underwriting opportunity focused on specialized recreational marine risks. You will manage new business and complex renewals across marinas, boat dealers, boat builders, yacht clubs, and rental boat operations. The role combines sophisticated underwriting judgment with portfolio profitability, risk quality, and regulatory compliance. You will serve as a trusted resource for brokers and agency partners while strengthening relationships across your assigned territory. As a senior contributor, you will also mentor underwriting team members and support their professional development. The position offers the opportunity to influence product expertise, loss control, service quality, and continuous improvement. It is well suited to an experienced commercial underwriter who brings strong industry knowledge, leadership, and relationship-building skills. Underwrite new business and large commercial renewals within the recreational marine segment, balancing risk selection with rate, retention, growth, and profitability objectives. Evaluate accounts involving recreational marinas, boat dealers, boat builders, yacht clubs, rental boat operations, and related marine businesses. Provide direction, coaching, and mentorship to Analysts, Raters, Underwriting Assistants, Junior Underwriters, and other underwriting team members. Delegate work appropriately while supporting team development, technical expertise, and consistent underwriting practices. Build and maintain strong relationships with agencies and brokers across an assigned territory, including conducting regular quarterly visits. Act as a primary resource for brokers, providing timely and accurate guidance on policies, coverage, billing, underwriting decisions, and other inquiries. Participate in relevant industry events and educational seminars, occasionally serving as a speaker to strengthen market knowledge and industry relationships. Coordinate loss control activities and support risk-management efforts designed to improve portfolio performance. Verify issued policies against quotes, applicable state requirements, carrier regulations, and operational standards, maintaining a target accuracy rate of 99%. Respond to agency communications within one business day while maintaining high service standards and efficient underwriting operations. Contribute to product expertise, professional training, continuous improvement initiatives, and departmental objectives. Requirements: Bachelor’s degree or equivalent education from a four-year college or technical institution, or at least 10 years of relevant experience and/or training, or an equivalent combination of education and experience. Strong experience in commercial underwriting, with relevant expertise in recreational marine or comparable specialty insurance markets. Demonstrated ability to underwrite complex new business and large renewals while balancing growth, risk quality, retention, and profitability. Strong knowledge of recreational marine risks, ideally including marinas, boat dealerships, boat builders, yacht clubs, and rental boat operations. Excellent judgment and analytical skills for evaluating risks, coverage, pricing, and compliance requirements. Strong broker and agency relationship-management capabilities, with confidence engaging stakeholders across an assigned territory. Demonstrated leadership and mentoring abilities, with the capacity to guide underwriting professionals and promote consistent best practices. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to provide clear and timely responses to brokers and internal stakeholders. Willingness and ability to continue professional development through industry education and external courses. AIMU, CIC, or CPC

jobgether-jobgether:lever:872eff9b-3871-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Ruby Developer (Ruby & Go) based in Germany. This is a senior backend engineering opportunity focused on building and scaling secure, reliable payment infrastructure for a global fintech environment. You will take ownership of the backend powering payment portals and integrations with payment service providers. The role combines Ruby on Rails expertise with Go development for high-throughput and latency-sensitive services. You will design end-to-end deposit and withdrawal flows while ensuring robust transaction processing, reconciliation, and failure handling. Security and reliability are central, with a strong focus on financial data protection and compliance. You will also contribute to technical direction, mentor engineers, and help evolve a high-performing international engineering environment. Design, build, maintain, and own backend services using Ruby on Rails and Go, with a focus on scalability, reliability, and maintainability. Lead the integration of new payment service providers and payment methods, including cards, bank transfers, cryptocurrency, and local payment solutions. Build and maintain end-to-end deposit and withdrawal workflows, ensuring secure and consistent movement of funds across the platform. Design, implement, and consume PSP APIs, webhooks, callbacks, and other integration mechanisms. Develop transaction routing, status tracking, reconciliation, and payment lifecycle logic. Implement robust handling for payment states, retries, idempotency, failures, and edge cases to ensure resilient transaction processing. Maintain strong security controls for payment information and support compliance requirements, including PCI DSS. Monitor existing payment provider integrations, troubleshoot issues, and proactively improve reliability and performance. Develop reporting, logging, and observability capabilities that support payment operations and technical troubleshooting. Support the integration of anti-fraud, AML, and KYC controls into payment workflows. Provide technical leadership through architecture discussions, code reviews, technical decision-making, and mentorship of other engineers. Requirements 5+ years of backend engineering experience, particularly in API-driven and integration-heavy environments.
